name: Footer banner
summary: The AhaSlides marketing site pre-footer call-to-action card (Webflow section-container > card-based-section img-card-section), matched to the live ahaslides.com: a pale pink illustrated card with a centred heading and a Get started free button, directly above the Footer. An optional paragraph sits between the heading and the button (the Enterprise variant), and an optional scroll-in reveal reproduces the fade-up used on the Compare page. Framework-free and bound to the shared --aha-* tokens.
highlights: Webflow section Footer banner, matched to the live ahaslides.com at 1440px, 768px and 375px
Card is a 1280px-wide, 16px-radius pink illustration with a centred heading (40px, 32px at 991px and below) and a pink Get started free button
Button takes the DS primary colours: Vivid Pink, darker on hover over 0.2s, the DS focus outline on keyboard focus
Heading, optional paragraph and button copy and link are per-page content
Optional --reveal modifier fades the card in and lifts the heading when it scrolls into view; reduced motion shows it at rest
